snippet.title: Halo CE: Casemate Full Game
snippet.description:
Credit to C4 Explosive Master for the mod in my video. The mod let you play as a squad member to infiltrate British Base to captured Gray Tech that should change course of the war. The AI, Weapons and Vehicle sandboxes got kitbatched from modders. No commentary in Halo CE: Casemate Full Game video. Leave a like, share, comment your thoughts and opinions about the mod in my video. Subscribe for more Halo Mod Contents and other videos.

Check out C4 Explosive Master's Casemate Mod:
